# PT Serif damage-number font

The optional **Diablo IV (PT Serif)** combat-text font uses unmodified PT Serif
Regular by Alexandra Korolkova, Olga Umpeleva and Vladimir Yefimov / ParaType.
It is licensed separately from addon code under SIL Open Font License 1.1.

- Upstream: [Google Fonts, PT Serif](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/6157dfaa640ca5738b4d1a7070fe389c3036d7fc/ofl/ptserif), pinned commit `6157dfaa640ca5738b4d1a7070fe389c3036d7fc`.
- Original and runtime filename: `PT_Serif-Web-Regular.ttf`; runtime directory `media/fonts/`.
- Size: 359,048 bytes. SHA-256: `a4951fade06ff8f09b7673aa81ffb65a8cd409e24d3289a6dc670bc4dda2557a`.
- Upstream Git blob: `5310691a999658437d6db608b9447d606598753e`.
- Complete upstream license: [PTSerif-OFL.txt](PTSerif-OFL.txt). The same complete copyright and OFL notice is embedded in the shipped SCT Lua comments so the runtime ZIP carries it.

Copyright (c) 2010, ParaType Ltd. Reserved Font Names: PT Sans, PT Serif and
ParaType. The file is neither renamed internally nor subsetted, converted or
modified. Only this Regular face is bundled; no Diablo IV game files, game font
atlas, Old Fenris font or third-party addon code is copied.

The visual-match evidence and its limits are in [DIABLO-SCT.md](../docs/DIABLO-SCT.md).
The selector names the actual bundled typeface and does not promise identical
Blizzard rasterization, font weight or visual parity in the packaged client.
